values.note: Full-hookup sites $45; the five non-electric tent sites $20. Online cancellations up to 15 days out are refunded less the reservation fee; none inside 15 days.

fees.source: https://www.washburncountyparks.us/parks/camping/minong__wild_river_trail_atv_campground/ ('Camping fees are $45.00 per night for R.V. sites and $20.00 per night for non-electric sites.'; cancellation policy); https://www.washburncountyparks.us/parks/camping/minong__wild_river_trail_atv_campground/sites/ (20 sites $45.00, 5 sites $20.00 for 2027-06-08..10); https://www.washburncountyparks.us/parks/i/lr/village_of_minong_wild_river_trail_rv_park___campground_rule.pdf ('Reservation Fee: is $8.00 per reservation/per site and is not refundable'), read 2026-11-16

values.note: Sites 1-10 and 16-25 full hookup; 11-15 tent sites without electric.

sites.source: https://www.washburncountyparks.us/parks/i/lp/wild_river_atv_campground_map.pdf ('Sites 1-10 and 16-25 are full hook-up $45/night / Sites 11-15 are tent sites $20/night and no electricity.'); https://www.washburncountyparks.us/parks/camping/minong__wild_river_trail_atv_campground/ ('The campground offers 25 sites ... 20 R.V. campsites with full hookups (electric, water, and sewer) and 5 sites without electricity'), read 2026-11-16

hookups.source: https://www.washburncountyparks.us/parks/camping/minong__wild_river_trail_atv_campground/ ('20 R.V. campsites with full hookups (electric, water, and sewer)'), read 2026-11-16

facilities.source: https://www.washburncountyparks.us/parks/camping/minong__wild_river_trail_atv_campground/ ('coin-operated shower facilities, flushing toilets, open-air picnic pavilion, firewood, and an R.V. dump station'), read 2026-11-16

values.note: Washburn County Parks' engine, or by phone/walk-in at the Village of Minong office; bookable up to 11 months ahead, closing 7 days before arrival, after which unreserved sites are first-come, pay as you go. Outside Apr 30-Oct 15 every site is first-come, with water and sewer depending on the weather.

booking.source: https://www.washburncountyparks.us/parks/camping/minong__wild_river_trail_atv_campground/ ('All campsites are reservable from April 30th to October 15th. Before April 30th and after October 15th, sites are available on a first-come, first-served basis; the availability of sewer and water is dependent on the weather - please call ahead.'); https://www.washburncountyparks.us/parks/i/lr/village_of_minong_wild_river_trail_rv_park___campground_rule.pdf ('Advance Booking: may be made up to 11 months in advance. Reservations must be confirmed at least 7 days prior to the planned stay. ... Inside of 7 days, all unreserved sites are treated as first-come, first-serve & pay as you go'; 'Minimum Reservation Booking: shall be 2 nights on non-holiday weekends and 3 nights before, during and/or after the holidays'; 'Maximum length of stay on any one campsite is fourteen (14) nights in succession'), read 2026-11-16

note: Village of Minong ATV/RV park in town beside the Wild Rivers Trail, with direct access to the Washburn County ATV trail network; ATV loading ramp, coin ATV wash, picnic pavilion and firewood. A walk to groceries, restaurants and gas. --Claude
summary: County reservation page, 2027 site search, village rules PDF and campground map read (village's own site refused, 406): $45 full-hookup / $20 tent confirmed, $8 reservation fee new; 25 sites (20 FHU + 5 tent) confirmed; facilities confirmed; booking re-sourced: min stay is 2 nights on weekends (not always) and 3 on holidays, 7-day cutoff then first-come, 14-night max, reservable Apr 30-Oct 15.
